title: FA3 ideas on SM100: warp specialization, S/O in TMEM, and softmax–MMA overlap

steps.title: Roles and S = Q·Kᵀ (single block, TMEM → probe)
Single-block attention: P through shared memory, O += P·V (V is MN-major), normalization and LSE
Full K/V loop: online softmax, softmax warps correct O in TMEM
causal: skip the blocks after the diagonal, mask only the diagonal block and the tail block
S double buffering: QKᵀ_{j+1} overlaps softmax_j

cases.name: n1
cases.purpose: N=1: the Q, K, V boxes each have only 1 valid row; TMA fills the other 127 rows with zeros; O = V, LSE = scale·q·k. The TMA store of O must clip the 127 out-of-bounds rows.

cases.name: one_block
cases.purpose: N=128 is exactly one block, B>1, H>1: the coordinate order (d, head, row, batch) of the 4-D tensor map and the grid mapping.

cases.name: short_tail
cases.purpose: N=37, D=128: one row spans two 64-column panels; the 91 padding keys must be masked.

cases.name: block_tail
cases.purpose: N=100, B>1, H>1, D=128: a single partial block; the tail clipping of O must not cross into the next batch.

cases.name: scale
cases.purpose: scale=1, logits in the hundreds: scale must come from p.scale; without subtracting the max it overflows.

cases.name: one_uniform
cases.purpose: Q=0: O is the mean of V, LSE = ln N. Missing or repeating the multiply by 1/ℓ, or a wrong ℓ sum, all show up.

cases.name: one_ones_v
cases.purpose: V=1: O must equal 1; if P of the padding keys is not 0, O exceeds 1.

cases.name: one_position
cases.purpose: V[j]=j/N: a wrong swizzle when writing P to shared memory, or a wrong MN-major descriptor for V (LBO/SBO, transpose bit), gives a wrong positional mean.

cases.name: tail
cases.purpose: N=300: 3 blocks; the last block has only 44 valid keys; the last Q tile has only 44 rows.

cases.name: peaked_d64
cases.purpose: D=64, FP16, large logits, N=513 is 1 more than a multiple of the block: the max changes in later blocks, so O in TMEM must be corrected by multiplying by α.

cases.name: peaked
cases.purpose: D=128, 7 blocks, large logits: the max is updated repeatedly.

cases.name: uniform
cases.purpose: Q=0, two blocks: LSE = ln N; a wrong ℓ correction ℓ·α makes it drift.

cases.name: ones_v
cases.purpose: V=1, 5 blocks: the O correction and the ℓ correction must use the same α for O to equal 1.

cases.name: position
cases.purpose: V[j]=j/N, 3 blocks: a wrong K/V stage index or parity reads the positional values of another block.

cases.name: ring
cases.purpose: 10 blocks, D=128 (2 stages): the ring buffer wraps 5 times; a wrong full/empty parity reads an old block or hangs.

cases.name: medium
cases.purpose: Medium-size random data, D=128: the full loop over 8 blocks.

cases.name: medium_d64
cases.purpose: Medium-size random data, D=64, FP16 (3 stages).

cases.name: multiwave
cases.purpose: 512 CTAs (about 3.5 waves, one CTA per SM): several CTAs run one after another on the same SM and reuse shared memory and TMEM; problems in barrier initialization, TMEM deallocation, or draining before exit show up only here.

cases.name: causal_n1
cases.purpose: causal and N=1: the only query sees only itself.

cases.name: causal_two_blocks
cases.purpose: causal, two Q tiles, large logits: the first tile must not process the second K block; the diagonal block of the second tile must be masked.

cases.name: causal_tail
cases.purpose: causal and N not a multiple of the block: the diagonal mask and the tail mask apply at the same time.

cases.name: causal_position
cases.purpose: causal, V[j]=j/N, D=128: a mask off by one reads the positional values of the future.

cases.name: causal_peaked
cases.purpose: causal and large logits: masked elements of the diagonal block must not take part in the max, and must not leave NaN.

cases.name: causal_uniform
cases.purpose: causal and Q=0: O[i] is the mean of V[0..i], LSE[i] = ln(i+1).

cases.name: causal_ones_v
cases.purpose: causal and V=1: O must equal 1, including row 0, which has only one key.

cases.name: causal_medium
cases.purpose: Medium-size causal, D=128: Q tile i processes only blocks 0..i.

cases.name: causal_medium_d64
cases.purpose: Medium-size causal, D=64.

cases.name: causal_multiwave
cases.purpose: Same as above but causal: CTAs have different block counts (1–8); CTAs that finish early interleave with CTAs still running.

cases.name: perf
cases.purpose: B·H=64, N=4096, D=128: 550 GFLOP, the same case as lab 22.

cases.name: perf_causal
cases.purpose: Same as above but causal: block skipping roughly halves the work; load is unbalanced across Q tiles.

cases.name: perf_d64
cases.purpose: D=64, FP16: fewer MMAs per key, so softmax takes a larger share.
